generate_video_from_image: generate a video from an input image using the StableVideoDiffusionPipeline with custom num_frames and guidance scale
encode_image_clip_embeddings: encode an input image into CLIP image embeddings using the StableVideoDiffusionPipeline _encode_image method
encode_image_vae_latents: encode an input image into VAE latents using the StableVideoDiffusionPipeline _encode_vae_image method
decode_latents_to_frames: decode latent tensors back into video frames using the StableVideoDiffusionPipeline decode_latents method with chunked decoding
prepare_noisy_latents: prepare initial noisy latents for video generation using the StableVideoDiffusionPipeline prepare_latents method
